metadata.case_name: CHEUNG WAI PING v. CHAN YUEN YEE

source: A CT brain scan showed a left parietal epidural haematoma and traumatic sub-arachnoid haemorrhage.
A CT brain scan showed a left parietal epidural haematoma and traumatic sub-arachnoid haemorrhage.

injuries.description: fracture of the left parietal bone
source: There was a fracture of the left parietal bone.
injuries.icd_description: Fracture of parietal bone of skull

injuries.description: right frontal and temporal lobe contusional haematoma
source: On the following day, on a finding of right frontal and temporal lobe contusional haematoma, another craniotomy was performed.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified traumatic haemorrhage in brain tissue

source: He was left with a depression in his skull for which it was suggested that he undergo cranioplasty, but he has not done so.
injuries.icd_description: Fracture of vault of skull, unspecified

injuries.description: left hemiparesis (left side lower and upper limb weakness)
source: By this time he was able to obey commands with slow mentality, but the tracheostomy was still in place, he had a tube for enteric feeding and he was doubly incontinent. He had right side 3 rd nerve palsy and left side lower and upper limb weakness.

By this time he was able to obey commands with slow mentality, but the tracheostomy was still in place, he had a tube for enteric feeding and he was doubly incontinent. He had right side 3 rd nerve palsy and left side lower and upper limb weakness.

injuries.description: severe head injuries / traumatic brain injury
source: The plaintiff suffered severe head injuries.

manifestations.description: unable to manage and administer his property and affairs
needs to be accompanied when he goes out
needs supervision when he takes medicine
able to walk unaided with steady gait but needs standby assistance for climbing stairs and outdoor ambulation; walks slowly and has reduced endurance

treatments_future: ongoing psychiatric treatment for three years
neurological follow-up visits (up to March 2008 as suggested by plaintiff's expert)

losses.description: Pain, suffering and loss of amenity arising from irreparable brain damage and inability to manage own affairs.
Loss of society (wife's claim under section 20C(1) LARCO).

losses.category: Loss of ability to do domestic tasks
losses.description: Loss of services provided to dependant (wife) due to plaintiff's inability to perform household tasks and handyman repairs.
